why_the_lane_could_not_do_this: OE-W4-PLATFORM-ROLES classified 76 constraints and found three removals still live in commissions/ and state/ paths outside its write scope. Writing there from a lane lineage would silently set currentness for every inheriting branch. It reported exact locators and replacement text and left its detector failing by design. That is the correct division: the lane finds, the path holder acts.
